title: Paedophile facing more than 200 new charges after NSW arrest
text: Paedophile facing more than 200 new charges after NSW arrest ‘I’d like to say to anyone who offends against children ... it’s only a matter of time before we arrest you.’ ‘I’d like to say to anyone who offends against children ... it’s only a matter of time before we arrest you. ’Ashley Paul Griffith, 48, was arrested once he arrived in NSW on Friday and has now been charged with more than 200 new sexual offences relating to 23 children.sentenced in Queensland to a minimum of 27 years in prison after pleading guilty to 307 offences, including ongoing sexual abuse and making child exploitation material, against 65 victims aged one to nine, beginning in 2003. Earlier this month a Queensland court agreed to Griffith’s extradition to NSW to face further charges. On Friday, detective superintendent Linda Howlett said Griffith had been arrested and charged by NSW Police for offences he allegedly committed during his employment at a childcare centre in Sydney’s inner west. He is alleged to have sexually abused 23 children aged between one and five between July 2014 and December 2017.“It’s a very important day and I’d like to take this opportunity to thank the victims’ families, as you can appreciate it’s a very challenging and difficult time for them, I’d like to thank them for their trust,” Howlett said. She described Griffith’s alleged offending in NSW as “horrific” and claimed the police case against him was “air-tight”.“We’re tlaking about the sexual abuse of small children over an extended period of time,” Howlett said. “It is quite horrific, not only for the victims but for their families as well. Hopfully today this charging will mean they will be able to have some sort of closure.”Griffith has been charged with 68 counts of sexual intercourse with child under 10, 42 counts of aggravated sexual intercourse with child under 10 – under authority, 69 counts of aggravated indecent assault and 23 counts of produce child abuse material .“As you can appreciate, if you’re a parent or a carer of a young child, this is probably the worst experience that they are ever going to go through so it has been extremely traumatic for them,” Howlett said. Assistant Commissioner Brett Greentree said the charges come after years of painstaking investigative work by Child Abuse Squad detectives.“ remained unwavering in their commitment to identify victims and pursue justice on their behalf,” he said. “This investigation involved the forensic examination of thousands of digital files, extensive victim identification inquiries and collaboration with law enforcement partners across Australia. “The allegations before the court are deeply disturbing and involve some of the most vulnerable members of our community. “Every child deserves to be safe and protected from harm.NSW Police is committed to ensuring those who exploit positions of trust to offend against children are identified, investigated and brought before the courts. ”“I’d like to say to anyone who offends against children, I give you this promise, it’s only a matter of time before we arrest you,” she said.If you or someone you know needs help, contact 1800 RESPECT , or Sexual Assault Counselling Australia on 1800 211 028, the WA Sexual Assault Resource Centre on 6458 1828 or 1800 199 888 or Lifeline on 13 11 14.
